title: The lids, lettered again
logline: The lids of the first five private boxes re-lettered in a steadier hand than 2021's, the old numbers showing under the new. He fixes the handwriting and not the count. The page draws both hands on one lid.

panels.composition: Close on a cardboard box lid with a number lettered twice, an older shakier version showing beneath a newer steadier one in black marker, four more lids stacked behind.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a cardboard box lid with a number lettered twice, an older shakier version showing beneath a newer steadier one in black marker, four more lids stacked behind, no words legible
